WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.ChanceBent: Looks like {shown}% of the wheel, but really comes up {real}% of the time.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.ChancePlain: The real chance of landing here.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.ClearBody: Remove all {n} wedge(s)? Nothing is written to the table until you save.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.CoinSummary: Coin on the wheel: {list} — {slots} of {total} slots, worth {expected} a spin on average.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.CouldNotLoad: That item could not be loaded — it may have been deleted.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.DropHint: Drag items here from the left, or from any compendium window.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.DryRunHint: Show the wheel exactly as your players will see it, and spin it. Nothing is broadcast, nothing is granted, and nothing is saved — it runs on what is on screen now, unsaved changes included.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.Dupes.name: One row per item
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.DupesHint: How to handle the same item appearing more than once. Worlds with several imported books have a lot of these.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.EmptyWheel: Nothing on the wheel yet. Drag something in, or roll a wheel.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.FillBody: There are {slots} slot(s) to fill, drawn from the {pool} item(s) your filters currently show. Nothing already on the wheel is touched.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.FillHint: Top the wheel up to its size with random prizes, leaving what is already there alone.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.HideUsed: Hide items already on the wheel
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.JackpotHint: Mark this as the grand prize — a gold edge on the wheel, and a bigger flourish when it lands. Only one wedge can hold it.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.LikelyDuplicate: Another entry shares this name, source, rarity and price — probably a true duplicate.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.MissingItem: This item no longer exists in the world. Replace or remove it.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.NameClash: Another wedge has this same name.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.NewHint: Creates an empty RollTable and opens the builder on it.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.NewPrizeHint: For rewards that are not items in this world: a favour owed, a title, a rumour, a homebrew relic you have not written up yet. The wheel shows what you type here, and the chat card asks you to hand it over.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.NoCoinYet: No coin on the wheel yet.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.OddsHint: How likely this wedge is, as a percentage of what its size suggests. 100% is honest; 25% makes a big, tempting wedge four times rarer than it looks.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.PadHint: Absorb the difference into the wedge that already has the most slots.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.PrizeTextHint: Shown on the reveal card when the wheel lands here. Leave it blank for a prize that needs no explaining.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.RefreshHint: Re-read every compendium and the world's items. Use after adding, removing or editing items in game.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.RepairHint: The item this wedge pointed at no longer exists. Keeping it turns the wedge into a custom prize: the name and art stay, and the wheel stops trying to grant something that is gone.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.RepairTip: This item is missing — keep the wedge as a custom prize
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.RerollHint: Swap this prize for a random one from the filtered list, keeping its slots
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.RollWheelBody: Draws from the {pool} item(s) your filters currently show, and fills all {slots} slots. Everything on the wheel now is replaced.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.RollWheelHint: Replace everything on the wheel with a random draw from the filtered list.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.SingleUseHint: Some systems file charged magic items as consumables too. This hides anything with several charges or that recharges on a rest.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.StockHint: How many of this prize exist. Blank is an endless supply; a number is spent as it is won, and the wedge is struck out when it runs out. A hoard should not hand out two Bags of Holding.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.Title: Wheel Builder
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.UnbalancedNote: It will still work — it simply becomes a {total}-slot wheel — but the odds will not be the ones you planned.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.Variants: {n} entries share this name, from different books. Expand to compare.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.VariantsHeading: Printings of “{name}” — pick the one you want
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.WarnCharges: This has several charges. It is expendable, but not a single use.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.WarnRecharge: This recharges on a rest — it is a permanent item, not a single-use one.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.WeightByRarityHint: Commoner prizes take more of the wheel than rare ones, so a legendary stays a thrill rather than a coin flip.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.Weighted: weighted — the wheel does not show its true odds
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.WheelSettingsHint: Give this wheel its own colours, sounds and rules. Anything left blank follows the world settings.
WHEELOFLOOT.Card.Speaker: The Wheel
WHEELOFLOOT.Fault.FormulaHigh: The formula rolls 1-{faces} but results only cover 1-{slots}. Normalise the table.
WHEELOFLOOT.Fault.FormulaLow: The formula only rolls 1-{faces}, so slots {from}-{slots} can never come up.
WHEELOFLOOT.Fault.Gaps: {count} slot(s) have no result (first: {first}). Normalise the table.
WHEELOFLOOT.Fault.NoRanges: No result has a slot range. Open the table and press the crosshair icon to normalise it.
WHEELOFLOOT.Launcher.NewHint: Create a new RollTable and start building a wheel on it.
WHEELOFLOOT.Launcher.NoTablesYet: There are no rollable tables in this world yet. Make a wheel now?
WHEELOFLOOT.Launcher.Notes: A player with no character assigned cannot be given loot, so their spin will be refused. A ⚠ on a table means its slots have gaps or overlaps — fix it in the builder first.
WHEELOFLOOT.Launcher.SpinsHint: The wheel opens for everyone, but only players with a spin can turn it. Each spin is spent the moment it is used, so nobody can spam it.
WHEELOFLOOT.Launcher.Title: Wheel of Loot
WHEELOFLOOT.Manager.DeleteFailed: Could not delete that wheel. See the console.
WHEELOFLOOT.Manager.DeleteNote: This deletes the RollTable itself. It cannot be undone from here — only Foundry’s own undo, if anything.
WHEELOFLOOT.Manager.DuplicateFailed: Could not copy that wheel. See the console.
WHEELOFLOOT.Manager.Empty: No wheels yet. Make one and it will appear here.
WHEELOFLOOT.Manager.Present: Hand out spins and present it
WHEELOFLOOT.Manager.RestockBody: Put every limited wedge on {name} back to a count, so it can be run again.
WHEELOFLOOT.Manager.RestockNote: Only wedges that already have a count are touched. Endless wedges are left alone.
WHEELOFLOOT.Manager.Title: Wheel of Loot
WHEELOFLOOT.Migrate.Body: This module used to be called sbts-loot-wheel. There is data in this world under the old name:
WHEELOFLOOT.Migrate.Done: Wheel of Loot: brought across {spins} spin(s) and re-stamped {items} item(s).
WHEELOFLOOT.Migrate.Failed: Wheel of Loot: the migration did not finish. Nothing was lost — see the console, and it will be offered again next session.
WHEELOFLOOT.Migrate.Items: {n} item(s) stamped as won from a wheel
WHEELOFLOOT.Migrate.Ledger: {n} outstanding spin(s) in the old ledger
WHEELOFLOOT.Migrate.Safety: Bringing it across only adds to those documents — nothing is deleted, renamed or overwritten, and you can safely say no and decide later.
WHEELOFLOOT.Migrate.Skipped: Wheel of Loot: left the old data alone. You will be asked again next session.
WHEELOFLOOT.Migrate.Title: Wheel of Loot has been renamed
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.AlreadyOnWheel: That item is already on the wheel.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.BadGiftTarget: That character cannot receive the gift.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.CannotAbsorb: Cannot absorb {n} slots into "{name}" — remove a wedge instead.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.CreateFailed: Could not create the table. See the console.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.EntriesMissing: Wheel of Loot: {n} wheel entries no longer exist in this world ({names}). Fix them in the builder first.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.GMOnly: Only the GM can present a wheel.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.GiftNotAllowed: This wheel does not allow gifting.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.GrantFailed: Wheel of Loot: could not give {item} to {actor}. Gave nothing.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.ItemsOnly: Only Items can go on the wheel.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.NoCharacter: You have no assigned character, so there is nowhere to put the loot.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.NoGM: Wheel of Loot: no GM is connected, so the wheel cannot be used.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.NoPlayers: There are no player users in this world.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.NoRoom: The wheel is already full at {n} slots.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.NoSocketlib: Wheel of Loot needs socketlib, which is not active. The wheel is disabled.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.NoSpins: You have no spins left on this wheel.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.NoTables: There are no rollable tables in this world yet.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.NobodyToGift: There is nobody else with a character to gift this to.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.NothingToPad: There is nothing on the wheel to pad.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.NothingToPreview: There is nothing on the wheel to spin yet.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.NothingToSave: The wheel is empty — add at least one prize before saving.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.NowhereToPutIt: There is no character to give this to — use Gift to hand it to someone.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.PoolEmpty: Nothing to draw from — widen the filters on the left.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.PreviewMissing: {n} wedge(s) point at items that no longer exist: {names}. They will spin, but nothing can be handed over.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.PrizeNeedsName: A prize needs a name — that is what the players read on the wheel.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.Recharges: "{name}" recharges on a rest — it is not a single-use item.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.RefreshFailed: Could not refresh the item list. See the console.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.Reindexed: Re-indexed {n} items. Every wheel entry still resolves.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.ResolveFailed: Could not finish the wheel. Ask your GM to check the console.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.RollFailed: Wheel of Loot: the spin could not be resolved. See the console.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.SaveFailed: Could not save the table. See the console.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.SpinAbandoned: {name} left before deciding, so their spin has been given back and the wheel is free again.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.SpinFailed: The wheel could not be spun. Ask your GM to check the console.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.SpinRefunded: Something went wrong with that spin, so it has been given back to you.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.TableNotFound: Wheel of Loot: that rollable table could not be found.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.TableNotReady: Wheel of Loot: "{name}" is not ready. {fault}
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.TwinOnWheel: "{name}" is already on the wheel from a different source. Both are now listed.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.WheelClosed: That wheel is no longer open. Ask your GM to present it again.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.WheelExhausted: Every prize on “{name}” has been claimed. Restock it in the builder before presenting it again.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.WheelRolled: Rolled a wheel of {wedges} prize(s) across {slots} slots.
WHEELOFLOOT.Setting.AllowGiftHint: Let a winner hand their prize to another player's character instead.
WHEELOFLOOT.Setting.AllowRefuseHint: Let a winner walk away with nothing. Turn this off to make every spin binding.
WHEELOFLOOT.Setting.AppliesNextWheel: A wheel is open now — the new look applies to the next one presented.
WHEELOFLOOT.Setting.AutoClose: Close when the spins run out
WHEELOFLOOT.Setting.AutoCloseHint: Shut the wheel automatically once every granted spin is spent. Turn off to leave it on screen until you close it.
WHEELOFLOOT.Setting.BackdropHint: How far to darken the map while the wheel is up. 0 leaves your scene fully visible behind it; 0.82 is the original.
WHEELOFLOOT.Setting.ChatCardHint: Where the record of each spin goes.
WHEELOFLOOT.Setting.ClearBody: Drops every setting “{name}” overrides, so it looks and behaves like the rest of your wheels. The world settings are not touched.
WHEELOFLOOT.Setting.CoinDenominationHint: The currency coin wedges are written in — gp, sp, and so on. A silver-standard campaign wants sp here.
WHEELOFLOOT.Setting.CoinPresetsHint: Amounts offered by the builder's Add coin button, separated by commas.
WHEELOFLOOT.Setting.CoinPreviewEmpty: No valid amounts — the default list will be used.
WHEELOFLOOT.Setting.ConfettiHint: Fire confetti when the wheel lands.
WHEELOFLOOT.Setting.DefaultSlotsHint: How many slices a brand new wheel starts with. Any existing wheel keeps the size it was built at.
WHEELOFLOOT.Setting.GMNeedsCredit: The GM needs a spin too
WHEELOFLOOT.Setting.GMNeedsCreditHint: By default a GM can spin freely. Turn this on to hold them to the same ledger as everyone else.
WHEELOFLOOT.Setting.HubIconHint: The image in the middle of the wheel.
WHEELOFLOOT.Setting.MenuHint: Colours, sounds, table rules and builder defaults.
WHEELOFLOOT.Setting.PaletteCustomHint: Two or more hex colours, separated by commas. Anything unreadable is ignored.
WHEELOFLOOT.Setting.PaletteHint: The alternating colours behind the wedge names.
WHEELOFLOOT.Setting.PreviewFallback: Not enough valid colours yet — showing the Fairground palette instead.
WHEELOFLOOT.Setting.PreviewNote: Preview — only you can see this
WHEELOFLOOT.Setting.PreviewWheelHint: Shows a real wheel with these settings, on your screen only. Nobody else sees it.
WHEELOFLOOT.Setting.ReduceMotionHint: Skip the spin and land on the result. Auto follows each viewer’s own operating-system preference.
WHEELOFLOOT.Setting.ResetBody: Puts every Wheel of Loot setting back to its default. Outstanding spins are not touched.
WHEELOFLOOT.Setting.SaveFailed: Could not save the settings. See the console.
WHEELOFLOOT.Setting.Speaker: Chat card speaker
WHEELOFLOOT.Setting.SpeakerHint: The name results are announced under. Leave blank for “The Wheel”.
WHEELOFLOOT.Setting.SpinSecondsHint: How long the wheel takes to settle. The GM's setting governs every client, so the spin stays in sync.
WHEELOFLOOT.Setting.SpinTurnsHint: How many times the wheel goes round before settling. More turns feel weightier at the same duration.
WHEELOFLOOT.Setting.ThemeHint: A whole look in one choice — sets the palette and hub together. Change either afterwards and the theme becomes Custom.
WHEELOFLOOT.Setting.TickSoundHint: Play the ticking track while the wheel spins. Affects only this client.
WHEELOFLOOT.Setting.TickVolumeHint: Loudness of the ticking track, 0 to 1. Affects only this client.
WHEELOFLOOT.Setting.WinSoundHint: Optional sound played when the wheel lands. Leave blank for none.
WHEELOFLOOT.Undo.Done: Wheel of Loot: the last win has been reversed and the spin refunded.
WHEELOFLOOT.Undo.Fail.error: The undo did not finish. See the console.
WHEELOFLOOT.Undo.Fail.itemGone: That item has already been removed from the sheet.
WHEELOFLOOT.Undo.Fail.noActor: That character no longer exists, so the prize cannot be taken back.
WHEELOFLOOT.Undo.Fail.noPurse: That character has no purse to take the coin back from.
WHEELOFLOOT.Undo.Fail.notGM: Only the GM can undo a win.
WHEELOFLOOT.Undo.Fail.notOurs: That item is no longer the one the wheel gave out, so it has been left alone.
WHEELOFLOOT.Undo.Note: The item is removed and the spin is refunded. Only the most recent win can be undone.
WHEELOFLOOT.Undo.Title: Undo the last win?
WHEELOFLOOT.Use.Charges: Several charges, but does not recharge
WHEELOFLOOT.Wheel.DryRunKept: Dry run — nothing was handed over.
WHEELOFLOOT.Wheel.DryRunNote: Dry run. Only you can see this, and nothing you land on is granted.
WHEELOFLOOT.Wheel.Exhausted: Every prize on this wheel has been claimed.
WHEELOFLOOT.Wheel.GiftHint: This puts {item} into someone else's inventory instead of your own. You keep nothing.
WHEELOFLOOT.Wheel.Orphaned: The GM reconnected, so this wheel is no longer running. Ask them to present it again.
WHEELOFLOOT.Wheel.RefuseWarning: You will not get another spin, and you walk away with nothing.
WHEELOFLOOT.Wheel.Watching: You are watching. The GM decides who spins.
